overall: The AG found the Gardner Conservation Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by posting a June 24 notice topic that listed only a property address ("827 Green St Proposal") with no description of the matter, and ordered future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the June 24 meeting notice topic "827 Green St Proposal" was insufficiently specific to advise the public of the issues to be discussed.
allegations.key_passage: By failing to include any information other than a property address, we find that the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: The Commission did not respond to the complaint within the required period; the letter reminds it of the 14-business-day response duty but does not rest its finding on this.
allegations.key_passage: The Commission did not respond to the complaint.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: We order the Commission’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution that a finding of a similar violation in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
